Make any photo square, remove one-colour backgrounds and borders, or crop images and animated GIFs into shapes (heart, star, circle…). Everything is processed in your browser: nothing is uploaded to any server.
Automatic two-step process: the image is made square by padding it with a white border and, at the same time, a version with that border removed (transparent) is generated. Only the colour touching the edges is removed; the inside is untouched even if it contains white.

Turn a rectangular image into a square without distorting it: blurred background, solid colour, stretched or cropped. Ideal for xat avatars, profiles and thumbnails.

The preview is the real result at the chosen output size. Rescaling uses step-down reduction so it does not look blurry or pixelated.
Remove borders (ClearBorder)
Removes the one-colour background or frame touching the edges of the image and makes it transparent. Pixels of the same colour inside the drawing are kept.
